selection_purpose: Per-case adapter: pipeline.py binds the selected case IDs and input paths from the frozen 1,800-case matrix.
transport_policy: Native prompts and scoring; Azure Responses adapter supplies reasoning settings and output budget instead of the packages' default chat-completion temperature/token settings.
invalid_case_policy: Exclude empty extractions, incomplete responses and unresolved parse/alignment failures from aggregate scores; retain status and raw outputs.
